text: Learn now teaches grading, mint marks and special years using the coins you have, and Your path shows what you have learned and what to try next.
You can now share a picture of your globe or a card of one coin or note from the Share button, and only that picture leaves the phone.
Legend now opens on an Unlock screen until Dad has issued this phone a licence.

The Collection now shows everything you've collected as a photo grid or list, with search, filters for coins, bills and countries, and a page for each item with its photos, facts, notes, edit and remove.
The Quarters screen shows a map of the United States lit with the quarters you have, a checklist of every quarter, and what you are still missing for each state.

The Globe: turn it with a finger to see the countries your coins come from lit in gold, tap a country to see your coins from there and the money it uses now and used before, and see which countries you have nothing from yet.
Legend now has a bottom bar with Collection, Globe, Quarters, Learn and Settings, and a Settings screen where you can change the theme, the text size and more.
Legend is here: it opens on your phone as an app, and tells you which version you have.
